title: CISA Catalog of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Log4j2 contains a vulnerability where JNDI features do not protect against attacker-controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Outlook Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Office Outlook contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows for a NTLM Relay attack against another service to authenticate as the user.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure contain a command injection vulnerability in the web components that allows an authenticated administrator to send specially crafted requests to execute arbitrary commands.
The TLS and DTLS implementations in OpenSSL do not properly handle Heartbeat Extension packets, which allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information.
